title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP11c — manifest fixture contract-copy bridge
goal: Make the base-owned manifest fixture preserve generic V3 contracts when it constructs an isolated candidate repository.
acceptanceCriteria: The manifest fixture copies docs/guards/V3/contracts recursively alongside the existing generic roots.
All existing positive and negative manifest assertions retain their verdicts.
No production command, manifest, policy, profile, workflow or required check changes.
